exposure: Uterine artery (UtA) Pulsatility Index (PI) values (normal vs. abnormal)
cohort: The study included 60 singleton fetuses with late fetal growth restriction (FGR) characterized by abnormal cerebral placental ratio (CPR).
finding: Late onset FGR fetuses with abnormal UtA PI showed shorter corpus callosum and cerebellar vermis length and delayed cortical development compared to those with normal uterine PI.
